snapshot.method: GitHub API for the default-branch head; npm registry metadata (read-only) for publication

claims.plain_claim: x402-pay pays x402 endpoints in USDC through the operator's own signer and refuses a seller amount above maxAmountUsdc before building a transaction.
authority_assumptions: The operator's wallet signs every transaction; the skill receives only a serialized transaction to sign.
claims.test_command: cd skills/x402-pay && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test

test_run.environment: node:22 container, network off after npm ci --ignore-scripts, sources checked out from git at bcd45a4

mocks_or_skips: Tests do not broadcast a transaction.
demonstrated_properties: mainnet payments refused unless allowMainnet=true
seller amount above maxAmountUsdc refused before a transaction is built
own payment confirmed at finalized commitment
README and SKILL.md state that the 5 bps fee leg is added on top of the capped seller amount
not_demonstrated: a cap on the total debit: the fee leg can take it up to 0.05% above maxAmountUsdc
a mainnet payment in this review pass
operational_limitations: 2.0.2 (Git, not on npm; npm latest 2.0.1): openclaw.plugin.json declares contracts.tools and repWasmPath/repZkeyPath, package.json openclaw.compat.pluginApi is >=2026.6.1 ("1.x" made OpenClaw 2026.x skip the plugin at discovery), README config nests settings under plugins.entries.x402-pay.config.

claims.plain_claim: x402-gate verifies a USDC payment on-chain at finalized commitment before serving, with a durable replay store required on mainnet.
authority_assumptions: The seller trusts its configured RPC endpoint.
Protocol fee leg goes to a treasury address pinned in source.
claims.test_command: cd skills/x402-gate && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test

test_run.environment: node:22 container, network off, sources from git archive of c103eac

demonstrated_properties: exactly one SPL Memo carrying the receipt hash required
recipient balance increase of at least the amount
5 bps fee leg to the pinned treasury
signature and nonce consumed in a file-backed replay store (required on mainnet)
payer ed25519 presenter authentication mandatory on mainnet
not_demonstrated: a signed receipt: the receipt is an unsigned SHA-256 hash both sides can compute
on-chain anchoring or netting (neither is done by this skill)
operational_limitations: 2.0.2 (Git, not on npm; npm latest 2.0.1): openclaw.plugin.json declares contracts.tools and the zk-rep config keys, package.json openclaw.compat.pluginApi is >=2026.6.1, README lists all four tools and the rep config, and rpcUrl is documented as required on mainnet.

claims.plain_claim: payment-session tracks metered and subscription charges for an agent session and suggests when to pay.
authority_assumptions: record_settled trusts the amount the agent reports.
claims.test_command: cd plugins/payment-session && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test

test_run.environment: node:22 container, network off after npm ci --ignore-scripts, sources checked out from git at bcd45a4

demonstrated_properties: in-memory per-session accounting
check_settlement_due never suggests more than the remaining budget
record_settled refuses an amount above the remaining budget
not_demonstrated: enforcement of the session budget on pay_x402: pay_x402 pays the seller's quote, bounded only by x402-pay's maxAmountUsdc (README, SKILL.md and plugin description say so from 0.1.1)
operational_limitations: 0.1.1 (README and description corrections) is in Git, not on npm; npm latest is 0.1.0.
0.1.2 (Git, not on npm; npm latest 0.1.1): openclaw.plugin.json declares contracts.tools and package.json declares openclaw.extensions; without them OpenClaw 2026.6.9 does not load the plugin.

claims.plain_claim: Liquefy packs agent run folders into vaults with format-aware engines and keeps an archive only after a byte-exact round-trip check.
claims.test_command: pip install -r requirements.txt pytest && pytest tests/
demonstrated_properties: round-trip verification with fallback to plain zstd (MRTV)

committed CI benchmark (benchmarks/latest_ci.csv, 2026-02-26): 114.7x versus zstd -19 45.3x on a repetitive JSON fixture; 5.86x (default) and 6.95x (ratio profile) versus 5.86x on VPC flow logs; docs/VAULT_APPLIANCE.md and docs/SKILLS_CATALOG.md now cite these numbers
not_demonstrated: the earlier 103.9x versus 63.8x figure (no committed result file; no longer cited)
near-parity on dense prose (1.02x versus 1.06x): from the same earlier pass, no committed result file
operational_limitations: Ratios depend on input format; engines target agent traces and machine logs.

claims.plain_claim: Liquefy vaults are encrypted with AES-256-GCM by default and packing stops when no secret is configured.
demonstrated_properties: AES-256-GCM with a PBKDF2-SHA256 per-tenant key (300k iterations) and the header as associated data
--no-encrypt is an explicit opt-out

claims.plain_claim: A vault fingerprint can be posted to Solana as an SPL Memo so a third party can check that the vault existed.
authority_assumptions: The memo is signed by the operator's own keypair; the SPL Memo program stores no state.
demonstrated_properties: memo text LQFY|<16 hex>|<16 hex>|<key fingerprint>: a 55-byte memo with 64-bit prefixes of the vault hash and chain tip; the module docstring and docs/VAULT_TOOLS.md now say so
not_demonstrated: full 32-byte hashes on-chain (only 64-bit prefixes are posted)
an anchor transaction in this review pass
operational_limitations: Default cluster is mainnet; pass --cluster devnet for tests.
For unsigned vaults the key fingerprint is derived from LIQUEFY_SECRET without a salt.

claims.plain_claim: The OpenClaw context-capsule skill replaces older turns with an extractive summary and keeps the most recent messages verbatim, locally and without network access.
claims.test_command: cd skills/context-capsule && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test
demonstrated_properties: deterministic extractive capsule (up to 1,400 tokens by default) plus the last 10 messages verbatim; no model call; no network
not_demonstrated: retrieval of omitted details (the skill has none)
end-to-end task token or cost savings
operational_limitations: 1.7.2 (Git, not on npm; npm latest 1.7.1) reads its settings from plugins.entries.context-capsule.config (api.pluginConfig); 1.7.1 read keys placed directly on the entry, a layout OpenClaw's config validation rejects.
